title: Gca Bay Area Ras Garba - Oct 10th By Sheth & Joshipura Team - Alap Group
description: Experience the Euphoria of Garba with GCA Bay Area Ras Garba
organizer: Gujarati Cultural Associaton Of Bay Area
long_description:
Experience the Euphoria of Garba with GCA Bay Area Ras Garba
Mark your calendars for the 10th of October, 2026, as the Gujarati Cultural Association of Bay Area brings you the GCA Bay Area Ras Garba. Hosted by the renowned Sheth & Joshipura Team of the Alap Group, this event promises to be an unforgettable evening of vibrant Gujarati and Multilingual Navratri/Dandiya performances. Immerse yourself in the rich cultural tapestry of Gujarati traditions, accompanied by the rhythmic beats of Dandiya.
A Grand Ensemble of Artists
Get ready to witness a spectacular showcase of talent, as the night will be graced by a myriad of skilled artists. With their unparalleled expertise in the traditional art forms, they will captivate your senses and leave you in awe. Their performances are sure to resonate with the audience, transporting them to the heart of Gujarat's cultural landscape.
A Celebration at Washington High School
The grandeur of this event will unfold at Washington High School, located at 38442 Boulevard, Fremont, CA, United States. Known for its safety and accessibility, the venue promises a hassle-free experience for all attendees. Its proximity to a host of Indian restaurants adds to the appeal, allowing you to indulge in some authentic Indian cuisine before or after the event. Rest assured, parking will not be a concern as ample space is available for all attendees.
Secure Your Entry Now!
Don't miss out on this enchanting experience. Tickets are now available with options to suit everyone's needs. General Admission is priced at $25.00, while a Group Of 8 or more can avail a discounted rate of $23.00 per ticket. Secure your spot now to revel in the magic of GCA Bay Area Ras Garba!
